svg.aria-label: Data flow: the demo's 4 Contoso CSV files are joined into data/input/sales_flat.csv (Bronze layer, 35 columns). The notebook reads its 11 mapped columns into a DuckDB table and writes output/sales.csv, numbers.json and 06-checks.md; the Power Query staging query Sales Flat reads output/sales.csv (Silver layer) and feeds the Sales fact and the Product and Customer dimensions; Date is built in DAX (Semantic layer). 10 measures read Sales, Date and Product (Analytical layer), and the fixed report reads the measures and the three dimensions. The slow report loads sales_flat.csv as is into one table with 10 slow measures.
